SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK FP-15: FHIRPath — §6.3 Types. Test these items: is type specifier, is(type), as type specifier, as(type). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.evidence: Native parser.cpp parseTypeExpression consumes at most ONE infix is/as typeSpecifier, so 'Patient as Resource is FHIR.Patient' -> EMPTY natively while fallback returns true (official grammar: expression ('is'|'as') typeSpecifier is left-recursive, chains valid). Also 'Patient is Resource is Boolean', 'contained as Observation is FHIR.Observation', 'Patient as Resource as Resource is FHIR.Patient'. Repro: .temp/qa/fp15_explorer2_2026_08_18/drill2.py
issues.root_cause: parser.cpp parseTypeExpression consumed at most one ('is'|'as') typeSpecifier despite the official grammar's left-recursive typeExpression rule
issues.resolution: Left-associative while-loop over is/as type specifiers; extension rebuilt + redeployed

issues.evidence: 'recorded is FHIR.instant' false on BOTH engines (typed string; name-only fhirFieldType lacks 'recorded', fallback fhir_path_to_type.json lacks path entry). Should be true. Repro: .temp/qa/fp15_explorer2_2026_08_18/drill.py
issues.root_cause: 'recorded' absent from native fhirFieldType and fallback path-to-type metadata
issues.resolution: Added recorded->instant in evaluator.cpp, fhir_path_to_type.json, fhir_model.py

issues.evidence: 'meta.lastUpdated is FHIR.instant' false on BOTH; native additionally says 'is FHIR.dateTime' TRUE (native/fallback parity diff: fallback false) — native fhirFieldType maps lastUpdated->dateTime. R4 types it instant.
issues.root_cause: native fhirFieldType mislabeled lastUpdated as dateTime (sibling primitive); fallback had no entry
issues.resolution: Moved lastUpdated to instant branch natively; added .lastUpdated instant fallback entries in both metadata copies

issues.spec_citation: FHIR R4 element definitions (ValueSet.url canonical, Condition.note.text markdown, Claim.total Money, Encounter.length Duration, Narrative.div xhtml)
issues.evidence: 'url is FHIR.canonical', 'note.text is FHIR.markdown', 'total is FHIR.Money', 'length is FHIR.Duration', "text.`div` is FHIR.xhtml" all false on BOTH engines (parity holds). Native fhirFieldType is name-only (url->uri, text->string) and cannot disambiguate per-path types; fallback JSON has per-path keys but correcting it alone breaks the dual-engine lockstep invariant (ARCH-002 family).
issues.root_cause: native fhirFieldType is name-only (field_name key) and cannot express per-path types; parity invariant blocks fallback-only correction
issues.resolution: Deferred: requires path-aware native field typing or single generated metadata source (ARCH-002 consolidation)
